title: Lakshmi and the First Lamp
audience: A 20-second visual proof for the Diwali film: families and festival audiences, phones first.
notes: This is a fresh 17.8 s proof, not a re-cut of the 60 s film. It tests the corrected staging rules: six shots, none over 4.2 s; real set dressing in every third; a new four-armed Lakshmi with a crown, a lotus base and open palms; a child and a street with lamps; a river with a lotus opening; a real eight-fold rangoli; a brass puja thali. Facts are the same public framing as the long treatment: Lakshmi is the goddess of prosperity and abundance; the lamp is the welcome; the lotus is her attribute. No invented date, place, person or family is used. The village is a generic Indian street, not a named city. The regional Kali/Rama/account-book line belongs to the longer film and is not in this proof.
